Name: Chest Preview
Author: sergiomadd
Description:
[size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q2fnlRc.png[/img]
[list]
[*]StardewValley 1.5.6
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ 3.16
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/glkpcY9.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Extract the mod file into the Mods folder in the game files
[*]Start the game with SMAPI
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/udKSQmT.png[/img]
It is highly recommended to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to configure this mod.
Configurable features:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Enable this mod: Enables the preview to show
[*]Show preview range: Lets you determine the distance in tiles from which the player must be relative to the chest to show the preview
[*]Preview menu UI size: Lets you choose between 4 scale sizes:
[list]
[*]Small (1) = 0.4
[*]Medium (2) = 0.5
[*]Big (3) = 0.6
[*]Huge (4) = 0.7
[/list][*]Show chest to preview connector: Displays the connection sprite between the chest and the preview
[*]Use keyboard key to show preview: Lets you determine a keyboard key to press in order to show the preview
[*]Keyboard key to press
[*]Use mouse button to show preview: Lets you determine a mouse button to press in order to show the preview
[*]Mouse button to press
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4CPPxxH.png[/img]
Chest Preview should show every vanilla item
If not please report the not/incorrectly shown item as a bug in the forum or the [url=https://github.com/sergiomadd/StardewValleyMods/issues]Github issues page[/url]﻿
Also, it is currently compatible with the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿->compatible but with bugs
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url]﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jjtE20o.png[/img]
